New Program

30 Day Challenge

Fired up to lead? Our free 30 Day Challenge helps you explore a run for office with daily questions, prompts, and exercises. No experience needed– just an email and a drive to make change. In one month, you’ll have a campaign plan built for you.

Our Impact

At the National Democratic Training Committee (NDTC), we train Democrats to run effective, winning campaigns at every level of government. Our free online trainings help build the bench of progressive leaders across the country. This is the work of strengthening our democracy. And we offer it all for free. Online. And accessible anywhere, anytime.
